segments.he: פעם אחד הי' איזה שאלה אצל רבינו ז"ל בפסח שנפל חתיכת מצה לתוך התבשיל לענין שאין אוכלים (גבראקט) המצה לתוך המים. ולא החמיר כל כך אמר העיקר שמירה במכנסיים "שמירה אין דיא הוזין" היינו העיקר הוא תיקון הברית בזה צריכין להחמיר מאד אבל בשאר דברים לא צריכים חומרות יתירות רק אם עפ"י ש"ע כשר לא צריכים להחמיר הרבה מאד וכמו שאומרים אנ"ש שהראשי תיבות ו'ח'י' בהם הוא ו'לא ח'ומרות י'תירות:
segments.en:
When my father studied between Minchah and Ma'ariv in Tzfas with the congregation, there were elders who would relate old memories. One elder told that he remembered a certain old gentile who had once told him the following story:

He and several other gentiles were servants of a nobleman who was cruel to them and tortured them with severe afflictions. They conspired together to kill him and lay the blame on the Jews. And so they did — at night they killed him. Fearing the authorities, they took the body on a stretcher and went to place it in the Ari shul [the synagogue of the Ari] to implicate the Jews. But before they arrived, at midnight, four men came toward them and would not let them pass and compelled them to turn back. They then went toward the Jewish cemetery — and when they came there, those same four men came out from the cemetery against them and again compelled them to turn back. They went to another Jewish location — and again those same four men came from there and drove them off. And so it was at every place they tried — until they were compelled to leave the body in their own house. In the morning the authorities found out — and they were forced to confess that they had killed him. Great punishments were inflicted on them — many could not survive and died. The survivors were aged by the suffering. And he himself remained alive, but his hair had turned white from the great suffering he had endured.
